title: Custom dictionary
description: Applies to both live Parakeet dictation and voice-note transcription.

fields.label: Replacement pairs
fields.description: Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, longest phrase first.

title: Voice-note transcription
description: Use the Transcriber glance panel or supported `domios plugin transcriber` dictation commands to install, select or test a live Parakeet dictation model.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: whisper.cpp model id (ggml-<model>.bin). small = multilingual, good balance. base = faster/lighter; medium / large-v3 = more accurate, slower.

fields.label: Language hint
fields.description: BCP-47 code (e.g. en, ru). auto detects the language per clip.

fields.label: Remote endpoint
fields.description: Optional GPU offload URL (e.g. http://host:7891/transcribe). When set, audio is uploaded there instead of running whisper.cpp locally — no ffmpeg/model download. Leave empty for offline local mode.
